Package ca.team.originkickoff.services

Class LotteryOrchestrator

java.lang.Object
ca.team.originkickoff.services.LotteryOrchestrator
public class LotteryOrchestrator extends Object
Orchestrates the complete lottery process including validation, draw, persistence, and updating other collections (event status, invitation statuses, notifications).
